gpu_tip: ~20GB total at 128K context. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus ~24GB of DDR5 system RAM is enough — Gemma 4's MoE design (the A4B in its filename) lets llama.cpp offload inactive experts to RAM without much of a speed hit.
mac_tip: Needs ~20GB — fits a 32GB MacBook Pro (M4 or M5) comfortably; a 24GB config is tight.
